# Concepts

- [[wiki/concepts/agent-connectivity|Agent Connectivity (Skills + CLI + MCP)]] — The idea that skills, CLIs, and MCP are complementary connectivity layers agents should combine, not a single universal mechanism to pick once.
- [[wiki/concepts/agent-memory|Agent Memory]] — Unified, agent-accessible memory built from ingested documents, knowledge-graph extraction, and embeddings, exposed to agents through MCP search/write tools.
- [[wiki/concepts/cli|CLI (as a connectivity layer)]] — Command-line tools as an agent connectivity layer — fast to adopt in sandboxed, local-execution contexts, but hard to govern once distributed to many users.
- [[wiki/concepts/orchestration|Agent Orchestration Placement]] — The architectural question of where and how an agent's multi-step planning logic runs — server-side as one composite tool, or client-side across several round-trips.
- [[wiki/concepts/skills|Skills]] — A convention for packaging reusable, portable capability instructions — typically a `SKILL.md` file — that an agent harness loads and invokes natively, outside the MCP protocol.
